title.zh: 多队列 PCoA 组合图

source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 截图颜色连通区域提取的近似点；重叠点和组别形状无法完全识别
provenance.en: Approximate coordinates extracted from screenshot colors. Some study assignments and control/IBD marker assignments are heuristic.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 各队列的特征表或统一距离矩阵；每个样本的 study、control/IBD 组别和 ID。
跨队列归一化/批次处理方法、PCoA 坐标及轴解释比例。
原始 PERMANOVA 设计，包括队列效应、协变量和置换约束。
en: Feature tables or a harmonized distance matrix; study, control/IBD group and ID per sample.
Cross-cohort normalization/batch handling, PCoA coordinates and explained variation.
Original PERMANOVA design including study effects, covariates and permutation restrictions.

preprocessing.zh: 先完成跨队列统一和 PCoA；把坐标与 study/group 合并。本项目只绘图和汇总边缘分布，不做批次校正或 PERMANOVA。
preprocessing.en: Harmonize cohorts and compute PCoA upstream, then join coordinates to study/group. Rendering summarizes marginal distributions but does not perform batch correction or PERMANOVA.

description.zh: 队列标识，与 styles 中 study 顺序一致
description.en: Cohort identifier matching the study order in style

description.zh: 实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.zh: 已转换的横轴坐标；不是原始特征矩阵
description.en: Transformed x coordinate, not a raw feature matrix
